description: ⚠️ Destructive: Remove an outbound rule from an Access Control Group. Set confirm=true to execute.

accessControlGroupNo.description: ACG number to remove rule from (required)

accessControlGroupSequence.description: Destination ACG number. Cannot be used with ipBlock.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute the destructive operation

ipBlock.description: IP block in CIDR format. Cannot be used with accessControlGroupSequence.

portRange.description: Port range (e.g., 80, 1-65535). Required if protocol is TCP or UDP.

protocolTypeCode.description: Protocol type code (TCP, UDP, ICMP, or protocol number)

name: ncloud_remove_acg_outbound_rule
